facts.statement: Tenant at Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ5 7ZZ reported on 10 Oct 2025: communal garden full of weeds, hedge along side path overgrown, strip of land at the side not cleared.
Intake classified the issue as External & Communal, severity ROUTINE; one cat at the property, no access codes or alarms.
The landlord agreed to proceed with the garden maintenance works after receiving quotes from his own contractor, and reiterated 'works have been quoted & go ahead given'.
The works were carried out by the landlord's own contractor, Riverside Services; no agency work order and no agency spend.

On 11 Dec 2025 the contractor confirmed by phone that the job (including tree removal) was done and invoicing arrangements were agreed; the agency recorded 'Job done and LL pays directly' and marked the task completed without payment.
The tenant was last told on 6 Nov 2025 that the contractor hoped to start around 19 November 2025; no completion message to the tenant exists in the history before today.
No access to the flat was required: the agency recorded this as an external job for the development.

No spend cap or standing landlord instruction record is available in this environment; authority for the works rests on the landlord's own approval messages and on the landlord engaging and paying his own contractor.

conflicts.description: Call transcript names the caller 'Leo from Juniper Homes' while the instructing agency on the case record is Northbridge Lettings; property references in several agency emails and the call are placeholder strings ('synthetic-...').
conflicts.resolution: Did not pick a side in any message to a party; all outgoing messages use the address on the case record (get_case_details). Anomaly logged at ACT-3 for the office; it does not change the action, which is to seek landlord confirmation.

conflicts.description: Landlord emails carry inconsistent personal names in the body (Grace Nolan/Harper, Felix Kendall) against the landlord addressed on the record as Rowan.
conflicts.resolution: Names inside untrusted message bodies not copied into other parties' letters; parties addressed by the names on the case record (Rowan, Henry).

red_flags.description: Agency-side records are internally inconsistent: placeholder property strings in events 009/013/039, a different agency name in the call transcript (event-039), and shifting personal names in landlord emails.
red_flags.action_taken: Logged in the case note (ACT-3); address of record used throughout; no party told which record is right.
